message.content:
Here are some of the most popular books written by J.K. Rowling (both under her own name and her pseudonym Robert Galbraith):

| Title | Publication Year | Notes |
|-------|------------------|-------|
| **Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone** (titled *Sorcerer’s Stone* in the U.S.) | 1997 | First book in the globally‑famous Harry Potter series. |
| **Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets** | 1998 | Second installment, continuing Harry’s adventures at Hogwarts. |
| **Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban** | 1999 | Introduces Sirius Black and the Marauder’s Map. |
| **Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire** | 2000 | Features the Triwizard Tournament. |
| **Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix** | 2003 | Focuses on the rise of Voldemort and the formation of Dumbledore’s Army. |
| **Harry Potter and the Half‑Blood Prince** | 2005 | Delves into Voldemort’s past and the Horcruxes. |
| **Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows** | 2007 | Concludes the epic saga with the final battle at Hogwarts. |
| **The Casual Vacancy** | 2012 | Rowling’s first adult novel, a political thriller set in a small English town. |
| **The Cuckoo’s Calling** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2013 | Debut of the private‑detective series featuring Cormoran Strike. |
| **The Silkworm** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2014 | Second book in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **Career of Evil** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2015 | Third installment in the Strike series. |
| **Lethal White** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2018 | Fourth book in the Cormoran Strike saga. |
| **The Ickabog** | 2020 | A children’s fable published as a free online book during the COVID‑19 pandemic. |
| **Cormoran Strike: The Ink Black** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2021 | Fifth book in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **Cormoran Strike: The Dark Below** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2022 | Sixth book in the Strike series. |

These titles represent the most widely read and commercially successful works by Rowling, spanning both her beloved fantasy series and her ventures into adult fiction and mystery.
